page.overview:
Who is Chew Mee?

Chew Mee is a minor Bond Girl in The Man with the Golden Gun. She is played by Françoise Therry.

James Bond meets Chew Mee when he poses as the hitman Francisco Scaramanga, in order to gain access to industrialist Hai Fat's estate. Bond sees Chew Mee swimming in Hai Fat's pool and she asks him to come in. Bond tells her he hasn't got a bathing suit to which Chew Mee replies that she doesn't either. As Bond is unbuttoning his shirt, Hai Fat arrives.
